title: Analysing Moral Bias in Finetuned LLMs through Mechanistic Interpretability

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with structured moral scenarios involving positive and negative side effects to evaluate intentionality attribution on a 0-10 numerical scale. The bias (Knobe effect) is quantified as the difference in mean intentionality scores between the negative and positive conditions. The study also employs mechanistic interpretability (Layer-Patching) on residual stream activations to localize and mitigate this bias across model layers.
